item.description:
GitHub Actions pop-up card; cleaner Board cards; Board names and icons

  • GitHub Actions opens as a pop-up card from its toolbar button, like Music: glass, an arrow, 560 pt wide. The card reopens at the same place, with the same rows expanded and the same scroll, also inside a run's job map. A row closes when a new run replaces it.
  • A pop-out button in the card header opens the floating GitHub Actions window. The card and the window can be open at the same time. The window keeps a margin from the screen edge; Settings has "Keep on top" and a background opacity slider.
  • Board cards: no colored strip on top; the tab-group tag sits top right. The bottom row shows only the status, one link count and PR numbers (up to 3, then +N). Click a PR number to open the PR in a browser tab.
  • The Board gives tabs and workspaces real names and icons, and card icons show on their tabs. Names and icons you set yourself are never changed. New: Regenerate Name and Icon in the card menu.
  • Board AI answers each message with a small fresh request (rules, board, memory, a short summary and the last messages).
  • Claude's multiple-choice questions show in the Devkitty panel: pick with clicks or keys 1–5, or type your own answer.
  • The Claude permission panel works again for sessions that were running when Devkitty restarted or updated.
  • Update download errors save their error codes in the bug report and diagnostics.
